generation.scope: Every standard finite Frobenius window with finite edges and opposite rank eight has a finite all-degree Koszul and two-sided AS regularity decision. Middle support three certifies regularity. Otherwise one parity is symmetric, so the low-rank symmetric-kernel test and the bisymmetric finite test decide every candidate, including one- and two-support nonreduced schemes. The new argument applies once to the blowup of a multiplicity-two or -three plane carrier, including nonreduced carriers.

open_mathematics: At opposite rank nine compare the dimensions of both pairs of marked slices inside the opposite pairing. Use a common four-space on at least one parity and determine which Artin marks still obstruct a symmetry. Also treat rank-eight positive-dimensional point graphs and rank-nine curved branching.
